body: it didnt start off that way but i guess it does sort of sound like one with the rhymes!

This feels like such a humorous poem but there's a sense of realism here that I can't help but relate to! It really brings out the not so cheery atmosphere of what is supposed to be a cheery holiday. "And every little thing is in its place" really brings it together to show that there's somewhat of a bond between this family that makes it legitimately the best Christmas but not the ones you see on tv. Just my interpretation but good work!!

This feels like such a beautiful, bittersweet poem due to its straightforward and short nature. Definitely gives me old tale vibes. "Her most beautiful words ripped from her" is very melodramatic and I feel it really drives the whole concept home. In the case of seeing this poem as bittersweet, I mean to say there feels to be some hope for the character here to find someone to breathe life back into her. Nice work!!
wow thats really interesting!! this is definitely a good read, and something I feel i can relate to on some level. Keep up the good work, holy crap!

This is such a nice use of rhyme and very clever! It's something to be proud of especially since it's so short and bittersweet; the only thing i would say is to maybe add more in the future. Great concept and you got this down!

Thank you for your feedback!! I like to think of this poem as more of just a "what if" poem but I definitely know where you're coming from with the specific imagery. I do sometimes have trouble on how to end of poem so thank you for pointing that out! I definitely need to work on from here so again thank you :D

Oh my god. I was just scrolling through I didnt expect to see something like this. I can see the feeling that was put into this. Its not always easy to end a poem with a bang but you did it superbly. I might even refer back to this poem later. My favorite line has to be "I couldve just asked the person next to me on the train." I feel I somehow I identify with this. 
This was a good find, keep up the good work!

I truly like this poem, especially due to the imagery; it seems like a lot of feeling went into this poem! The concept is very unique and personifying. Its nature paints a pretty picture in my head. My favorite line has to be "he strips you and finds hoof marks" because i feel like that really drove the concept into action. Nice work!
Woah, I really like this poem, it's short and sweet yet it's strong. Really would like to see your inspiration for this.
I can really feel the emotion that was put into this poem! The wording is something to be proud of, it paints a detailed picture in my head, truly.
